ns2:section.sectionText: First-year students who took MACS 140 or 150 in Fall 2022 should be able to enroll in MACS 260 if seats are available at the time of their registration. Should first-year students who took MACS 140 or 150 in Fall 2022 run into a registration error and seats are still open, contact the Student Services Center at 217-244-4329 or media-ssc@illinois.edu for assistance. *Students must register for the lecture and a discussion/lab section.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman class standing.
